metadata.title: About ScanEat | QR Menus & Restaurant Operations in Saudi Arabia
metadata.description: ScanEat is a Saudi restaurant operations platform: QR digital menus, WhatsApp ordering, live kitchen and waiter dashboards, and owner analytics in one system.

hero.title: Built for restaurants running modern, real-time service
hero.description: ScanEat replaces slow, outdated ordering flows with a connected digital experience — from a guest's first QR scan to live kitchen tickets, waiter coordination, and the numbers behind each day.

highlights.title: QR-powered digital menus
highlights.caption: Guests scan the table code and the menu opens in their browser — no app.

highlights.title: WhatsApp ordering built in
highlights.caption: Order confirmations and status updates reach customers on WhatsApp.

highlights.title: Live kitchen & waiter dashboards
highlights.caption: New orders hit the kitchen screen instantly and move to waiters when ready.

highlights.title: Owner analytics, in real time
highlights.caption: Revenue, order volume and top-selling items on one dashboard.

positioning.title: Restaurant technology should feel invisible when it works well
positioning.description: We believe the best hospitality tools are the ones that reduce waiting, remove unnecessary steps, and fit naturally into the rhythm of service. ScanEat is designed around that principle: less friction for guests, less complexity for operators, and a cleaner digital layer for the restaurant experience.

story.title: A simpler approach to digital dining
paragraphs: Many restaurant tools are built like back-office software first and guest experiences second. That usually leads to cluttered interfaces, slow mobile flows, and products that feel harder than the problem they were supposed to solve.

ScanEat was created as a more focused alternative. The goal was not to overload restaurants with features, but to build a product that improves one of the most visible parts of service: how guests access menus, make decisions, and place orders.
The result is a platform centered on clarity, speed, and operational practicality — designed to support modern hospitality without disrupting it.

operations.title: Practical enough for daily service, polished enough for modern brands
operations.description: ScanEat is not just about replacing printed menus. It connects the guest's order to the kitchen, the waiter, and the owner in real time — while keeping every role's dashboard focused and simple.
items: Live kitchen order queue — no missed tickets, no relaying orders by hand
Real-time waiter coordination, even during a rush
One owner command center for menu, staff, and live order activity
Role-based dashboards for owners, kitchen, waiters, and admins

principles.title: What defines the way we build

items.title: Operational simplicity
items.text: Restaurants need systems that reduce friction during service, not create more of it.

items.title: Fast mobile experiences
items.text: Guest interactions should feel instant, intuitive, and natural on any device.

items.title: Practical product design
items.text: Every feature should solve a real workflow problem for staff, managers, or guests.

productView.title: Technology that supports hospitality, not distracts from it
productView.description: Our aim is to create software that feels calm, efficient, and credible. That means strong typography, focused interfaces, reliable performance, and product decisions grounded in how restaurants actually operate.

mission.title: To help restaurants run better service — from guest order to kitchen to daily numbers
mission.description: ScanEat exists to reduce operational friction across the whole service flow, not just at the menu. We're building for restaurants that care about speed, clarity, and the quality of the experience they present — from the first scan to the kitchen ticket to the numbers behind the day.

teamBanner.title: A hospitality-first product with a more serious digital standard
